Sync recording

Line up any recording with the drill. Play the recording and tap TAP at each spot on the list as you hear it (the downbeat where that set's move starts). The app stretches the timing in between using the score. Use ◀ ▶ to nudge a spot by 0.05 s, and Check to hear it with the click.

Count-in

TempoThe drill's timing was tapped by hand, so it wobbles a little on every count. Steady locks each section to one tempo, matched to the score (78, 128, 160, 104, 120…), and keeps the rit. bars and the pauses between movements.
Click onDrill counts follow the drill. Music beats follow the score, so half-time and feel-in-2 spots click every beat.
Big number showsMetronome screen
MusicScore = the band parts from the MusicXML, played by the app (basic sounds; follows the tempo slider exactly; Part 4 has no score so it's silent). Recording = your show audio file, synced to the drill's counts.

Licensed to
Built from the drill writer's own files: performers, sets, counts, measures, notes and the count-by-count music timing come from the Pyware drill file; dot positions come from the printed coordinate sheets. Between sets, dots move in straight lines spread evenly over the counts (holds and staggered moves aren't modeled yet). Prototype for internal testing only. The drill design remains the property of its designer.
